suspected_root_cause: OAuth token cache expiry bug causing intermittent 401 errors
resolution: Restarted auth service pods and cleared Redis cache. Deployed fix in v3.0.8 to properly handle cache expiry.

suspected_root_cause: Deploy v2.3.1 changed connection pool size from 50 to 20, causing pool exhaustion under normal load
resolution: Rolled back to v2.3.0. Fixed config in v2.3.2 with pool size 100.

suspected_root_cause: Elasticsearch reindex cron job running during peak traffic hours causing search latency spike
resolution: Killed reindex job, rescheduled to run at 2 AM UTC.
